title: Secure a cable in a HUMMEL M20 gland with a 24 mm spanner
instruction: Feed the cable until its green mark meets the gland cap and hold it there, tighten the cap with the spanner into the green sector, return the spanner to its rest, and release both hands.
context: Electricians (O*NET 47-2111.00; 821,000 US employees in 2025) fit enclosure cable glands so that a pull on the cable is taken by the gland, not the terminals. One hand holds the cable at its marked depth while the other tightens the dome cap with a spanner to the maker's 4.5 Nm; a pull test then checks retention. The named HUMMEL HSK-K 1.209.2000.50 takes the specified 10 mm cable.
setup: Open Hammond 1591ESBK ABS enclosure, 190.4 x 110.6 x 60.8 mm, clamped on a 110 x 190.4 x 30 mm reusable wood block with two padded clamps; its near wall at x=255 mm has a 20.5 mm hole with a HUMMEL HSK-K 1.209.2000.50 gland (M20 x 1.5, 24 mm flats, NBR seal, 6-12 mm cable, maker cap torque 4.5 Nm) on axis y=15, z=65. Cap reset: run down by hand to the reset mark, 60 degrees before first contact (enrollment). A 50 mm dial behind the cap pointer has 5-degree ticks: blue at first grip (60; 10 N/<1 mm enrollment), green from 150.0 to below 153.44, nominal 4.5 Nm at 150 and red from 153.44. Cable: Miguelez H05VV-F 3G2.5 82010312-50, 10 mm, 200 mm sheath plus 20 mm cores, a 4 mm green band whose centre is 50 mm from the sheath end; origin (90, 15, 65), sheath end (180, 15, 65), on open U supports at x=0 and 170. Spanner: GEDORE 894 24 / 6575570, 24 mm open end, 215 mm, 15-degree jaw, 154 g plus a 50 g grip sleeve centred 165 mm from the jaw; jaw centre (215, 40, 35), handle toward +y, on a head rest and sleeve cradle. Lot B moves only the spanner 20 mm toward -x. Coordinates are mm, x forward, y left, z above the table. Lots A/B are averaged; the screenshot shows A.
scoring: Each lot, 0 if: wrong path through the bore, sheath less than 5 mm past the inner gland end, sheath-mark centre more than 3 mm from the cap's outer face, a hand within 8 mm of cable, gland or spanner, under 1 s still, cap angle at/past red or observed cap/spanner torque above 5.0 Nm, a failed pull, or unknown state. Otherwise: cap short of first contact 0.25; at or past first contact but not snug 0.5; snug 0.75: the seated spanner turned the cap to at least 4.5 Nm on the seal curve (green sector) with at least 90% of the seal work done through the jaw and at least 1 s of measured spanner-cap torque and cap reaction at or above 4.5 Nm. 1.0: snug, spanner used and back on its rest, and three axial pulls of 50 N held 1 s each leave the cable displaced 2 mm or less after unloading. Real trial: ruler for the mark; dial for the cap angle against the enrolled C, G (4.5 Nm) and R (5.0 Nm) marks; snug also needs a 4.5 Nm wrench check that clicks within 5 deg; spring scale for the pulls. Average A/B.
run_limit: 3,200 steps (160 seconds at 20 Hz) per layout
reset_notes: Ready-made specimens: four HUMMEL HSK-K 1.209.2000.50 glands with M20 locknuts and 1 m of Miguelez BARRYFLEX-MAN H05VV-F 82010312-50 cable; cut four 220 mm pieces, each with 200 mm sheath and 20 mm prepared cores. Three gland/cable pairs support one-time enrollment; reserve the fourth for damage checks. Budget about $239 for specimens, enclosure, spanner, clamps, reusable supports/sleeve and measuring tools, excluding tax/shipping and robot/cameras; itemized in README. Enroll each pair once (about 10 min, README "Real-trial procedure"): accept 10.0-10.2 mm cable; first contact C = first 15-deg step where a 10 N, 1 s pull moves the cable <1 mm; green G = 4.5 Nm wrench click (60-120 deg past C); red R = 5.0 Nm click; three 50 N pulls at G must leave <=2 mm. Between trials: loosen cap to its reset mark 60 deg before C, inspect sheath/seal/threads, restore cable on both open supports and tool on its rest, and check enclosure and sleeve for slip. B moves only the tool 20 mm toward -x. Replace damaged stock. Estimated reset for enrolled stock: 2-3 minutes, not a measured time. Fixture fabrication and enrollment are one-time work; no casting, drying or curing per trial. The torque-angle curve and damage onset are estimates; no physical enrollment has been performed.
fidelity: 0.3 Nm free drag, 90 deg from first grip to 4.5 Nm and 50 N pull obtained by phone from a technician who works with this product (Nov 2026). Reactive brake uses cubic interpolation; four compliant pads approximate NBR. Estimated cap lead 1.5 mm/turn; rigid cable lead/two hinged tails. Native spanner-cap contact gates work. Three 1 s pulls, 2 mm residual limit. The 5.0 Nm rejection line is a benchmark estimate; damage onset and the intermediate curve are unmeasured.
scores: All tiers require mark +/-3 mm, hands clear and 1 s stillness. 0.25: before C; 0.5: C reached; 0.75: spanner sustains all three load signals >=4.5 Nm for 1 s, below 5 Nm; 1: also three 50 N pulls, <=2 mm residual and parked tool. Scripted A/B 1/0.5; Dream-1 A/B 0/0.
